context: AI sales intelligence: agents on top of a company's CRM that find who to sell to next.
summary: Forward deployed means working inside customers' setups: wiring their CRM, configuring the product for their case, and turning what keeps coming up into features.

highlights.title: New opportunity signals
highlights.text: Added three opportunity detectors to the product: a prospect moving away from a competitor's tool (spotted in their job posts), a new sales leader taking the job, and lookalikes of an existing customer.

highlights.title: Data the team can trust
highlights.text: Synced the customer base with the CRM and the product, then cross-checked all three and sorted every mismatch by type and confidence, so fixes are made on evidence, not gut feel.

highlights.title: Feature requests that reach the roadmap
highlights.text: Rebuilt the product request log out of no-code, with an agent that triages what customers ask for on behalf of customer success.

highlights.title: Support agent
highlights.text: Built an agent that handles bug reports and feature requests, scoped tight for a first version so it does a few things reliably.
